con3-exposition-p9-en: Is our Lord Jesus Christ true God, one of the holy Trinity, perfect in divinity and perfect in humanity, the same truly God and truly man, consubstantial with the Father as regards his divinity and with us as regards his humanity, acknowledged in two natures without confusion, change, separation, or division?
con3-exposition-p10-en: Are there two natural volitions or wills and two natural principles of action in Christ, without division, change, partition, or confusion, his human will following and subject to his divine and all-powerful will rather than opposing it?
con3-exposition-p11-en: Is it forbidden for anyone to produce, write, compose, consider, or teach another faith or creed so as to overturn what has been defined, with bishops and clerics who do so deprived of rank and monks or layfolk excommunicated?
lat3-canon1-en: If the cardinals cannot fully agree on a papal successor, is the one chosen and received by two thirds to be held as Roman pontiff, even if a third party disagrees or appoints someone else?
lat3-canon2-en: Are the ordinances of the heresiarchs Octavian and Guido, of John of Struma who followed them, and of those ordained by them void, and are those who received ecclesiastical dignities or benefices through these schismatics to be deprived of them?
lat3-canon3-en: Must no one be chosen bishop unless he has already reached the age of thirty, been born in lawful wedlock, and is shown to be worthy by his life and learning?
lat3-canon4-en: Are archbishops on visitation limited to forty or fifty mounts, cardinals to twenty or twenty-five, bishops to twenty or thirty, and archdeacons to five or seven, so as not to overburden subjects with procurations?
lat3-canon5-en: If a bishop ordains someone as deacon or priest without a definite title from which he may draw the necessities of life, must the bishop provide for him until suitable clerical wages are assigned, unless he can support himself from his own or family inheritance?
lat3-canon6-en: Must prelates not pass sentence of suspension or excommunication without a previous canonical warning, unless the fault is such that by its nature it incurs the penalty of excommunication?
lat3-canon7-en: Is it forbidden to demand anything for the enthroning of bishops, abbots, or ecclesiastical persons, the installation of priests, burials and funerals, the blessing of weddings, or other sacraments?
lat3-canon8-en: Must ecclesiastical ministries, benefices, or churches never be assigned or promised before they are vacant, and must vacant prebends or offices be conferred within six months on persons able to administer them worthily?
lat3-canon9-en: Is it forbidden for the Templars, Hospitallers, and other professed religious to exceed the privileges granted by the apostolic see by disregarding episcopal authority, receiving churches from lay persons, admitting the excommunicated to the sacraments, or appointing priests without the bishop's knowledge?
lat3-canon10-en: Is it forbidden for monks to be received in a monastery for money or to keep money of their own, and must they remain in larger communities rather than being stationed alone in towns, cities, or parish churches?
lat3-canon11-en: Must clerics in holy orders who keep mistresses in open concubinage either cast them out and live continently or be deprived of ecclesiastical office and benefice?
lat3-canon12-en: Is it forbidden for clerics supported by ecclesiastical revenues to become advocates before a secular judge or take on secular jurisdiction under princes, except when defending their own case, their church, or the helpless?
lat3-canon13-en: Is it forbidden to obtain several ecclesiastical dignities and several parish churches, and must the person entrusted with a church be able to reside there and exercise care for it himself?
lat3-canon14-en: Must pluralism whereby some hold six or more churches contrary to the canons be corrected, and is it forbidden for the laity to appoint or remove clerics and distribute church property without regard to the authority of bishops?
lat3-canon15-en: Must goods that clerics have received from their churches remain under the churches' control whether they die intestate or wish to bestow them on others, and are those who appoint deans for a fee to exercise episcopal jurisdiction to be deprived of office?
lat3-canon16-en: In every church, should what is determined by the greater and senior part of the chapter always prevail and be put into effect, unless the smaller and junior party shows some reasonable objection?
lat3-canon17-en: If founders of churches or their heirs support several candidates, should the one with greater merits chosen by the greater number be in charge, or if that cannot be done without scandal, should the bishop arrange as he sees best according to God's will?
lat3-canon18-en: In every cathedral church, is a master to be assigned a proper benefice to teach the clerics of that church and poor scholars, and is it forbidden to demand money for a licence to teach?
lat3-canon19-en: Is it forbidden for governors and officials of cities to impose heavy and frequent burdens and exactions on churches, afflicting them so that the priesthood is oppressed?
lat3-canon20-en: Are those abominable jousts and fairs commonly called tournaments forbidden, and is anyone who dies in them to be deprived of church burial even though forgiveness is not denied when requested?
lat3-canon21-en: Must truces be inviolably observed by all from after sunset on Wednesday until sunrise on Monday, from Advent until the octave of the Epiphany, and from Septuagesima until the octave of Easter?
lat3-canon22-en: Should priests, monks, clerics, lay brothers, merchants, and peasants enjoy proper security in their coming and going and work on the land, and is it forbidden to impose new tolls without the approval of kings and princes?
lat3-canon23-en: Wherever enough lepers are gathered under a common way of life to establish a church with a cemetery and their own priest, should they be allowed to have them without contradiction, provided the parochial rights of established churches are not harmed?
lat3-canon24-en: Should those who provide the Saracens with arms and necessaries to attack Christians, or who for gain act as captains or pilots in Saracen pirate vessels, be cut off from the communion of the church and excommunicated?
lat3-canon25-en: Should notorious usurers be refused communion of the altar and christian burial if they die in that sin, since usury is forbidden in both the Old and New Testament?
lat3-canon26-en: Are Jews and Saracens forbidden to have christian servants in their houses, either under pretence of nourishing their children or for service or any other reason?
lat3-canon27-en: Are those called Cathars, Patarenes, Publicani, and by other names, together with their defenders and those who receive them, under anathema for publicly proclaiming their error?
